resources.string: MacroDroid, Tasker and similar apps send commands to Guzz with intents and get events back when a transcript is ready. Guide and sample macros: docs/intents.md.
Allow other apps to control Guzz
When off, Guzz ignores every command and sends no events. Share to Guzz still works.
Leave empty to skip the check. When set, commands must include a matching secret extra.
Any app on the device can receive events. When off, events only carry the file name and request_id.
Save transcripts next to the source file
Only with \"All files access\" and a path source; otherwise saved to the chosen folder.
Not granted: only files in Source folders or URIs with a grant can be read.
Paths inside these folders can be read without \"All files access\" (e.g. Recordings).
Exempt: broadcast commands can start the queue with the screen off.
Not exempt: Android blocks broadcast commands from starting the queue while Guzz is in the background.
Off: the queue still runs but shows no progress notification and no Stop button.
Tap a line to copy it. Package of this build: %1$s
Sends a fake FILE_DONE with request_id = test, to try a macro that listens for events.
Turn on \"Allow other apps to control Guzz\" first.
Guzz could not start the file it just received
Android does not let Guzz run in the background right now. The file is still in the queue: tap to open Guzz and start. Exempt Guzz from battery optimization so it starts on its own next time.
Added to the queue but not started: %1$s
Guzz only transcribes audio / video files, skipped: %1$s
